wayIn.what: See what each reading points to, then follow the suggested world or any world card.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan every page in one pass, with one plain line on what to do first on each.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Put a room of lamps out, or set keepsakes on a shelf in the one order the clues allow.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Order the lights of a postcard by depth from how they shift, or spot which turned sky is yours.

worlds.name: the gravity well
worlds.what: Aim a probe through a ring past a well, or order three moons by their periods and count the orbits.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Call the stars back in the order they flashed, or find the two false lines in a logbook entry.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Order the stars by when their echoes return, or unmix a chord from the sum of its beats.

worlds.name: the pulse loom
worlds.what: Count where two beat cycles cross, or say which way a strobed wheel seems to turn and when it repeats.

worlds.name: the pendulum hall
worlds.what: Say when a rack of pendulums meets again, or tune a spring so the swing crosses in time.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Find the order the lanterns rise from the clues, or add the winds to say where one drifts.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Decide which plants get water from their tags and readings, or order the stems by age.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Work out the hour a front arrives, or read the pressure map for where the wind blows.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Count the folds of a weave and spot its mirror, or count the bands of a moire to find the hidden screen.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Infer a tape's rule from its rows and write the next, or find the one cell that changed.

worlds.name: the light table
worlds.what: Measure a slit spacing from its fringes, or order three filters so the most light passes.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Say which domino lanes cross their gaps, or find the point where a loaded plank balances.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Read a soil core for the depth of the water table, or mix two bags to a target blend.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Fire scrambled letters into a word, or climb a word ladder one letter at a time.

worlds.name: the cipher cabinet
worlds.what: Count a note's commonest letters to crack the wheel that shifted it, or find the route a turning key reads a note by.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: File four impossible specimens by their clues, or spot the one that breaks the drawer's rule.

worlds.name: the shadow theatre
worlds.what: Work out where the lamp stands from a shadow's size, or match four shadows to their cutouts.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Turn a wheel of letters so the stars spell the word, or judge which omens hold for your sky.
